entities.name: Putative CoaBC
observations: 414-aa query has 43–44% identity and 97–99% coverage to reviewed bacterial CoaBC homologs; function is inferred by homology.
Pfam matches flavoprotein domain PF02441 (aa 5–181) and DFP domain PF04127 (aa 198–408), consistent with bifunctional CoaBC architecture.
Likely catalyzes phosphopantothenate + cysteine ligation and phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylation in coenzyme A biosynthesis; exact activity is not experimentally verified for this query.

entities.name: CoA biosynthesis
observations: Reviewed CoaBC reference homologs participate in two sequential steps of coenzyme A biosynthesis: phosphopantothenate-cysteine ligation followed by decarboxylation.
